files.title: File:3 Crawford, L.D. & Martha E. House west and south facades Sowers - Crawford Farms Historic District Douglas Co KS.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Sowers-Crawford Farms Historic District
The exterior walls are finished with wood lap-siding, the roof is finished with corrugated metal, and the foundation and porch piers were built of limestone. 

The south façade has a centered front door and four double-hung, wood windows, two on either side of the front door.

files.title: File:2 Crawford, L.D. & Martha E. House south facade Sowers - Crawford Farms Historic District Douglas Co KS.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Sowers-Crawford Farms Historic District
The Lanty D. Crawford House is a two-story, framed, National Folk I-house with a rectangular plan, a side gable roof, and ruins of the original one-story, framed house.

files.title: File:4 Crawford, L.D. & Martha E. House south and east facades Sowers - Crawford Farms Historic District Douglas Co KS.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Sowers-Crawford Farms Historic District
The east elevation has a gable-end with a double-hung, wood window centered on the first and second stories. 

At the corners, there are pilasters or corner trim with cornice detail.

files.title: File:5 Crawford, L.D. & Martha E. House north and west facades Sowers - Crawford Farms Historic District Douglas Co KS.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Sowers-Crawford Farms Historic District
The north elevation has the ruins of the one-story frame addition; part of its gable roof is intact.
